interventions.fielded_force_presence: make insurgent formations ineffective and unavailable while preserving armed member state
interventions.local_armed_membership_access: hide incumbent residence only while live recruitment snapshots local armed-member access
interventions.persistence_exit: force recruited members to exit and neutralize the remaining public social signal at each generation boundary
interventions.social_control_placebo: restore social-control state after influence while preserving social exposure and behavior

design.same_tick_cascades: excluded by the live frozen access snapshot

control_mediation.interpretation: Control is downstream in this loop. The causal inputs back into recruitment are social exposure, local armed-member access, and effective local formation access. Restoring social-control state does not change the matched membership trajectory.

identified_loop: cross-local public behavior writes social exposure
social exposure supplies recruitment access and enters recruitment intensity
armed membership supplies future local member access
armed membership converts into local fighter manpower
fighter manpower can materialize an effective local formation
armed members broadcast future insurgent social signal
member mass raises organization survival social base

persistence_layers.armed_membership: supports local recruitment access and fighter-manpower generation
persistence_layers.public_sympathy_after_exit: live member exit removes armed membership but leaves insurgent sympathy, which can continue cross-local exposure
